action_description: In-place spear extension facing NORTH-EAST, back three-quarter view. Begin in the supplied grounded ready pose and extend the RIGHT arm in one strong diagonal thrust UP-RIGHT, ending exactly in the supplied contact pose. Left arm balances behind torso, knees flex. One broad steel spearhead on one wooden shaft angled up-right throughout. Fixed planted feet, no translation or turn toward camera, no horizontal east-facing pole, no duplicate weapon, no stone or floor. Preserve adult proportions, skin, clothes, scars and ankle chains. Extension only, no return.
